body:
Skip shared-state fan-out when no affected client tokens were collected. Apps that define `rx.SharedState` avoid the unnecessary registered-App lookup when there are no other clients to update.

Add benchmarks for private counters, linked counters, multi-client fan-out, `app.modify_state`, and link/unlink cycles. Benchmark state registration and shared-state flags are isolated so collecting or running these scenarios does not change ordinary event-processing benchmarks. Fan-out waits have a timeout, and scenario teardown drains pending updates before closing the state manager.

Regression tests cover the empty fan-out guard, benchmark isolation, and stalled-update cleanup. The internal-state construction in the guard test also type-checks against current `main`.

Validation: full unit suite with coverage, all pre-commit hooks, the CodSpeed benchmark suite, and targeted tests on current `main`. A real app was also exercised across three independent browser clients for linking, room isolation, unlink/relink, background and API updates, computed values, and multiple shared-state classes.
title: Skip shared-state fan-out when no clients need updates
